pageProps.title: Linux DRM - 구조와 전체 그림
pageProps.review: Linux DRM(Direct Rendering Manager)의 탄생 배경과 전체 구조, /dev/dri 장치 노드(card, renderD)와 권한, drm_driver·drm_device·drm_file 핵심 구조체를 Linux v6.19 소스로 설명합니다.
pageProps.description: An overview of the Linux Direct Rendering Manager (DRM): why it exists, the user and kernel stack, the /dev/dri device nodes, and the core structures drm_driver, drm_device and drm_file in Linux v6.19.
